description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. Prepare a surgical planning package by completing all of the following in a single session: (1) create a bone segmentation mask and generate a 3D surface reconstruction from it; (2) export the 3D surface as a Wavefront OBJ file to /home/ga/Documents/skull_surface.obj; (3) export a screenshot of the current InVesalius view as a PNG image to /home/ga/Documents/surgical_view.png. Both output files must be created. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
